title: Commentaries of Proclus on Euclid, Vol. 2
author: Proclus (Taylor trans)
description: The second volume of Proclus's commentary on Euclid in Thomas Taylor's translation. It continues the connection between geometrical reasoning, first principles and the philosophical interpretation of mathematical knowledge.
